newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen flat or up on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen flat or up on Monday.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to stay flat or rise on Monday after last week's 0.7-percent gain amid a heavy primary market schedule.

Analysts said Friday's stronger buying after price-fixing and rises in continuous trade signalled a Monday rise but that metals trader Impexmetal's 222-million-zloty initial public offering this week could draw cash and keep the bourse flat.

They said stocks could react to March earnings reports released late last week and that Okocim should not be helped by Friday's news it expects 1997 net profit to fall to 16-18 million zlotys from last year's 27.2 million zlotys.
The brewer said the lower net would be due to large investment in marketing and distribution and would not be a signal of the deteriorating financial standing of the firm.
